treatment: Rule registry ({id, wave, severity, hint template}), check decorator and phase runner authored from design 5.1 and 5.2; the 31 wave-1 entries are registry data written for this repository

deviations: the reference reports message text only and stops at 20 errors; here every reference is classified by what it points into, located, and cascade-aware

treatment: ST-009 red draft and SZ-001 slice size rules authored from design 5.1

State machine rules SM-001, SM-002, SM-003, SM-005 authored from design 5.1; terminal states are derived here, so the reference rule about leaving a terminal state cannot occur and SM-005 reports the derivation instead
CS-004 case traces a requirement, authored from design 5.1
RQ-001 trace-complete and RQ-002 coverage authored from design 5.1 and 5.4
Completeness report (slot status and severity per document level) authored from design section 6 and the skeleton specification
Slice-mode and full-mode check entry point (pending, one-edit typo warning, pending-bind, cascade suppression, known ids for the remote check) authored from design 5.3
